U-0003.summary: Replace the queue's anonymous Comparator with a lambda of the same body (it has no state and doesn't use this), with its parameter types spelled out so the diamond still infers PriorityQueue<Slot>; drop the Comparator import.

U-0006.summary: Write Effort.describe's switch expression with arrow cases, merging the labels that shared a value (1 and 2, 3 to 7). Every case yielded, so none fell through, and the values are the same.

U-0007.summary: Make Task a record: its components are the three fields it had, the constructor's checks move into a compact constructor, and the record's equals replaces the hand-written one over the same fields. getTitle, getPriority and getMinutes stay, so no caller changes; hashCode and toString stay as they were.
review_notes: The record's equals treats a null title as a value; the old equals threw NullPointerException on it. No caller makes a task without a title.
